source_documents.title: Photophysical Properties of an Azine-Linked Pyrene− Cinnamaldehyde Hybrid: Evidence of Solvent-Dependent Charge-Transfer-Coupled Excimer Emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: In water, PYNC shows the characteristic feature of excimer formation exclusively. However, in all other solvents, the excimer band is present alongside the charge transfer emission band.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Excimer band in all solvents, CT band outside water.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Thus, it could be concluded that the high-energy band was due to the pyrene excimer and the polarity-sensitive band was due to excited-state intramolecular charge transfer in PYNC.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Band assignment: excimer (high energy) and ICT (polarity-sensitive).

reference_evidence_units.quote: with a Stokes shift value ranging from ∼5480 cm−1 (in chloroform) to ∼7750 cm−1 (in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)) with quite higher excited-state dipole moment value than that in the ground state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solvatochromic Stokes shift and larger excited-state dipole.

reference_evidence_units.quote: On the other hand, increment of viscosity freezes the single-bond rotational motions in PYNC, a flexible motion responsible for nonradiative energy dissipation, thereby increasing the charge transfer phenomenon in the same
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Viscosity freezes single-bond rotations and enhances the CT emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Analogy to earlier cinnamaldehyde probes; no rate data.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PYNC was found to be totally nonfluorescent in the solid state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Non-emissive solid, used to rule out AIE as the origin of the water band.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Viscosity freezes single-bond rotations, suppressing nonradiative decay and raising the CT emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The polarity-sensitive band is intramolecular CT emission (Lippert-Mataga, larger excited-state dipole).

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The high-energy band is assigned to pyrene excimer emission (exclusive in water).
